entries.wants: what the ctrl+e key does from anywhere in the terminal interface: opens the New epic page
entries.where: key hint on the bottom line of the terminal interface, lower case, two words at most
entries.text: new epic

entries.wants: what the ctrl+o key does from anywhere in the terminal interface: opens the panel about the epic that is open, beside the log (its details, board, people and side questions)
entries.where: key hint on the bottom line of the terminal interface, lower case, one or two words
entries.text: epic panel

entries.wants: what the ctrl+s key does on the New epic page: starts the epic with what the page holds
entries.where: key hint in the row of keys under a form, lower case, one word
entries.text: start

entries.wants: explanation under the Folder field of the New epic page: the folder the epic works in; left empty, the epic works in a temporary directory of its own, made as it starts
entries.where: one short line under a form field, sentence with full stop, under 20 words
entries.text: Left empty, the epic works in a temporary directory made for it as it starts.

entries.wants: explanation under an environment role's field of the New epic page: where this environment role of the flow works; left as Folder, it works in the folder the epic runs in
entries.where: one short line under a form field, sentence with full stop, under 20 words
entries.text: Where this role works; left as Folder, it works in the epic's folder.

entries.wants: explanation under the Resume field of the New epic page while no epic is picked: an earlier epic of this flow can be picked here, and the new epic carries on from where that one stopped
entries.where: one short line under a form field, sentence with full stop, under 20 words
entries.text: Pick an earlier epic of this flow to carry on from where it stopped.

entries.wants: refusal shown on the New epic page when Start is pressed while an epic is already going in this folder: an epic is going here; stop it or wait for it to end before starting another
entries.where: one sentence with full stop, shown in red under the form
entries.text: An epic is already running here; stop it or wait for it to end first.

entries.wants: refusal shown on the New epic page when Start is pressed while the terminal interface is following an epic on another machine's daemon: a new epic is started from this machine's own epics; press esc to come back first
entries.where: one sentence with full stop, shown in red under the form
entries.text: Press esc to leave the remote daemon before starting an epic here.

entries.wants: status shown under the form of the New epic page while the daemon checks what was filled in, before the epic starts
entries.where: one word with an ellipsis character (…), like the page's `Reading…` and `Starting…`
entries.text: Checking…

entries.wants: line said in the transcript after the New epic page started an epic in another folder than the one this terminal interface is open in: the epic was started in {folder}; it is listed under /epics. Keep {folder} and the literal `/epics`
entries.where: one or two short sentences with full stops, in the transcript of the terminal interface
entries.text: Started the epic in {folder}. It is listed under `/epics`.

entries.wants: line said in the transcript after the New epic page started an epic in no folder (a temporary directory of its own): the epic was started in a directory of its own, {folder}; it is listed under /epics. Keep {folder} and the literal `/epics`
entries.where: one or two short sentences with full stops, in the transcript of the terminal interface
entries.text: Started the epic in its own directory, {folder}. It is listed under `/epics`.

entries.wants: what the left and right arrow keys (and the digits 1 to 4) do in the epic panel: go to the previous or next tab (Details, Board, People, Side questions)
entries.where: key hint on the bottom line of the terminal interface, lower case, one or two words
entries.text: tab

entries.wants: what the up and down arrow keys do in the epic panel: move to the line above or below
entries.where: key hint on the bottom line of the terminal interface, lower case, one word
entries.text: move

entries.wants: shown in the Board tab of the epic panel when the epic's flow never asks a person anything and so keeps no board
entries.where: one short sentence with full stop, shown dim in place of the list
entries.text: This flow keeps no board.

entries.wants: shown in the People tab of the epic panel when the epic's flow has no role that a person fills
entries.where: one short sentence with full stop, shown dim in place of the list
entries.text: This flow has no role for a person.

entries.wants: shown in the Side questions tab of the epic panel when no side question has been asked yet: none yet, and which key asks one. Keep the literal `a` as the key
entries.where: one short sentence with full stop, shown dim in place of the list
entries.text: No side question yet; press `a` to ask one.

entries.wants: shown in the Side questions tab of the epic panel when the epic has opened no conversation yet, so there is no session to ask a side question of
entries.where: one short sentence with full stop, shown in place of an answer
entries.text: No harness session is open in this epic yet.

entries.wants: question of the box that asks before a side conversation is closed in the epic panel: close the side conversation with {name}? Keep {name}
entries.where: question in a confirmation box, one short question
entries.text: Close the side question with {name}?

entries.wants: explanation in the box that asks before a side conversation is closed: what was asked and answered in it is no longer shown; the epic is not touched
entries.where: one sentence with full stop under the question of a confirmation box
entries.text: What was asked and answered in it leaves this list; the epic is untouched.

entries.wants: explanation in the box that asks before a line of the board is removed: the flow no longer reads this line
entries.where: one sentence with full stop under the question of a confirmation box
entries.text: The flow no longer reads this line.

entries.wants: explanation under the Side question field of the form that asks a side question from the epic panel: a side question is answered by a read-only copy of the conversation picked, and never reaches the epic
entries.where: one or two short sentences with full stops, under a form's title
entries.text: A read-only copy of the chosen harness session answers this, and it never reaches the epic.

entries.wants: label of a state on the Details tab of the epic panel for an epic that has ended (the others are the page's `Running` and `Stopping`)
entries.where: one word, capitalised, a status label
entries.text: Ended

entries.wants: note under a question in the transcript of the terminal interface, for a question whose flow gave it a custom view that a terminal cannot draw: the custom view of this question is in the web page{where}; Enter answers it here with the plain form. Keep {where} exactly as written, directly after the words `web page` with no space before it, and keep the key name Enter capitalised
entries.where: one line in the transcript under a question, one sentence, no full stop needed at the end, under 22 words; use the page's own nouns `custom view` and `plain form`
entries.text: The custom view is in the web page{where}; Enter answers here with the plain form
